claims.title: Contractive gradient descent can have uncomputable loss-decay exponents

interface: A fixed rational strongly convex C1,1 squared-ReLU objective has known minimizer zero and globally contractive unit-step gradient descent; only the rational initial point varies.
limits: The hard output is an asymptotic loss-decay exponent or a binary-horizon rate decision, not finding a minimizer. Fixed dimension does not imply fixed precision or memory.
status: source_derived_unreviewed; the universal interpreter and linked proof/code package were not acquired or independently verified.
